title: Road Bike Tire Test: Cadex Aero Tire 28
notes: Independent lab page read 2026-11-01 (published 2026-08-03): 28-622, specified 220 g, measured 214 g, measured width 26 mm, tubeless with 20 ml sealant; 11.4 W at 80 psi (29 km/h, 42.5 kg); wet grip 77; tread puncture 42; available sizes 28-622 and 30-622. Rating 2.0/5, 'Not Recommended': the tread is just 21 mm wide, the sidewalls are 'extremely weak and thin', and the reviewers call the combination a safety concern in corners.
